correctness.rationale: For each label-two set F, exactly the edges between ground vertices unused by F are forced to have label one; all other non-two edges are freely zero or one. Inclusion-exclusion counts all F with exactly s incident ground vertices, yielding every coefficient without duplication. The extremal bound 2m+binom(w,2)>=n-1+(w-1)(w-2)/2+1_{n-w odd} has equality exactly for parity-compatible w=1 or2, where F must be a perfect matching, establishing all minimum functions. Independently checked every labeling for n=3..5 (59805 total), every F for n=3..6, and optimum counts through n=18 using actual verify.py. Finite checks corroborate rather than replace the proof.

originality.rationale: The same-graph 2023 Zec theorem establishes only the minimum value n-1 and gives constructions of optimal functions; this is acknowledged prior work, not republished as new. The new finite expression counts every RDF by weight and structurally characterizes and counts all minimum functions. The 2021 Roman-polynomial paper treats other specific families, not line graphs of complete graphs. Related indexed complete-multipartite and chain-graph records are not equivalent graph classes. These comparisons support originality with explicit residual priority risk.
residual_risks: A previously published or unindexed table could encode the same coefficients under edge Roman domination of complete graphs.
The 2009 general extremal paper was not available as full text; no conclusion about the absence of results in its body follows from its abstract alone.
The literature search cannot establish absolute priority or exclude unpublished results.

value.rationale: J(n,2) is the fundamental triangular/Johnson family, and known Roman minimum weights do not quantify the degeneracy or whole distribution of feasible functions. This work determines the full all-order weight enumerator, not just a single weight, and a natural exhaustive perfect-matching classification and exact count of minima. The parity difference is intrinsic to vertex-covering edge configurations, and the complete distribution can serve as exact input for weighted counting and sampling. No downstream theorem or publication-scale contribution is claimed.
